verdict.rationale: Bugbot is itself an AI assistant. Users can delegate PR review to it automatically or on demand by commenting `cursor review` / `bugbot run`. They can steer it with `.cursor/BUGBOT.md` guidelines and natural-language effort instructions, and community users report it finds genuine bugs. However, the delegable task is limited to review: acting on findings hands off to separate Cursor surfaces (the Cursor IDE or cursor.com/agents) rather than happening inside Bugbot. Missing for 10: delegation of tasks beyond PR review within Bugbot itself, and in-product execution of fixes rather than handoff to other Cursor agents.
